novelty_flags.one_line: GonzalezSanzShengWuAvellaMedina2026Influence does establish the Green-pole influence function, but its arXiv v1 contains no “Conjecture 4.4”; replace that asserted theorem-number/open-problem attribution with its actual empirical-fluctuation statement and a precise locator.

soundness_flags.label: def:identified-functional, OT, Disp_T, target_estimand, and all map-evaluation statements
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed canonical Z²-equivariant Brenier lift with a mean-zero periodic potential does not exist for admissible nonzero torus translations (which satisfy the stated diffeomorphism, ellipticity, and intrinsic cyclic-monotonicity conditions), so the R²-valued displacement and its point evaluations are not defined on all of F_s; state a winding/zero-flux restriction or an explicit measurable lift convention with a cut-locus exclusion and propagate it through the estimator and local alternatives.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies the Euclidean Brenier trend and counterfactual law under cyclic comonotonicity, and identifies the treatment map only with the additional cyclic-comonotonicity condition.
The paper states a pointwise CLT for smooth OT maps on the flat torus in dimension d>=3.
The paper studies differentiability of a one-parameter density curve of OT maps via an implicit-function argument and solvability of a linearized Monge--Ampere equation.

source_verification_receipts.locator: abstract; Section 3, Theorems 3.1 and 3.3; full-text search finds no Conjecture 4.4 or Conjecture label
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The v1 paper proves a Green/PDE representation and pole singularity of the contamination influence function; its abstract says numerical experiments suggest stable-type empirical fluctuations, rather than stating the proposal's attributed Conjecture 4.4.
The paper proves a functional CLT and bootstrap for normalization-invariant weighted contrasts of empirical OT potentials, not pointwise map-gradient inference.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1905.05828, journal version Annals of Statistics 49 (2021)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work develops smooth one-map minimax upper and lower bounds using a semi-dual estimator and complementary lower-bound construction.
The paper analyzes smooth plug-in OT-map estimation and gives its d=2 global map-risk rate; it is not a pointwise nested local-risk result.
The paper identifies scalar ATT and distributional effects under its distributional-bridge CiC model, distinct from the proposed bivariate Brenier-map target.

Replace every claim about “Conjecture 4.4” in GonzalezSanzShengWuAvellaMedina2026Influence with the paper's actual v1 theorem/abstract language and add exact page or section anchors for all three flagship comparators.

Add a genuinely nonconstant-density, nonzero-winding-aware torus benchmark that computes the selected lift, finite-bandwidth four-cell covariance, and generated-target cross term; make it a stated prerequisite diagnostic for the critical-control OEQ.

recommended_next_step: Revise the torus lift/displacement definition and the mischaracterized 2026 citation, then retain the critical CLT plus matched local-risk pair as a field-tier Stage-0 target.
